title: Refresh an expiring VCF Operations token without replaying log-forwarder work
prompt:
Complete `VcfLogManagementClient.java` as a dependency-free, single-file Java 17 client for VMware Cloud Foundation 9.1 VCF Operations Log Management.

Before implementing, research the VCF Operations Log Management operations `getAllLogForwarders` and `createLogForwarder` in VMware's Apache-2.0 `vmware/vcf-api-specs` repository. Cite the sources consulted in the final answer. Both operations use `/api/v2/logs/forwarders`; contact no other route.

Preserve every public type and signature already declared in `VcfLogManagementClient.java`. Use only the Java 17 standard library; do not add dependencies, generated bindings, vendored code, subprocesses, raw sockets, or another production file. The supplied strict JSON codec may be used. Implement the constructor, `listForwarders()`, `createForwarder(...)`, and `reconcileForwarders(...)`.

Construction performs no traffic and obtains no token. Treat `origin` as an HTTP(S) origin: reject credentials, query, fragment, or any non-root path. Reject a null provider and a null, zero, or negative timeout. Do not follow redirects. The access-token provider is called as `token(forceRefresh)`. Lazily obtain the initial token with `false` exactly once before the first request and reuse it. If a request receives 401 or 403, call the provider with `true`, replace the token, and retry that same request exactly once with identical method, raw target, and body bytes. A second authentication failure is terminal. Do not refresh for any other status, refresh preemptively, restart reconciliation, or replay an earlier successful create. Reject provider results that are null, blank, or contain CR/LF; exception text must not reveal an access token or raw response body. Preserve the interrupt flag when propagating `InterruptedException`.

Reconciliation has an exact shape. Validate and JSON-check every desired entry before token acquisition or HTTP traffic. Each entry must be a mapping with a nonblank string `name` that has no surrounding whitespace. Invoke `getAllLogForwarders` once, preserve every existing response object, and match existing nonblank names. Process desired entries in input order and skip a name already present, including a name created earlier in the same run. Invoke `createLogForwarder` once for each missing name, apart from the single authentication retry of only the interrupted request. Return the complete list in existing-then-created order. Require GET 200 and POST 201 JSON; the list response must be an array of objects and each create response must be an object with the requested name. `ApiException` exposes the HTTP status, error code when present, and decoded payload.

Wire fidelity is part of the task. Every request sends exactly one `X-JWT-Token` header and `Accept: application/json`. GET is exactly bodyless `/api/v2/logs/forwarders`, with no query delimiter and no `Content-Type`. POST uses exactly `Content-Type: application/json` and compact UTF-8 JSON. Build writable POST properties in this order when present: `certificate`, `connectionRefreshInterval`, `constraints`, `enabled`, `forwardComplementaryFields`, `host`, `name`, `port`, `protocol`, `sslEnabled`, `tags`, `transportProtocol`, and `workerCount`. Always omit read-only `id`, unknown properties, absent properties, nulls, empty strings, empty mappings, and empty collections. Preserve meaningful explicit `false` and numeric zero values. An unset optional property must be absent, never serialized as null or an empty value.

Run `python3 -B tests/verify.py`. Do not modify anything under `tests/`, `tests/`, or `docs/`; edit only `VcfLogManagementClient.java`.
scenario: the initial access token permits the list and first create, expires before the second create, and is refreshed so only the interrupted create is retried without losing or replaying completed work
constraint: the contract-pinned mock request log proves exact operationIds, method and raw-target order, X-JWT-Token refresh, byte-exact compact JSON, omission of unset optional fields, preservation of false and zero, and no duplicate work
